ticket.summary: Electric water heater rumbling/popping during heating cycles, no leak and normal temps — sediment buildup; booked flush & sediment service.
mitigation_advice: Reassured no immediate danger; no shutoff needed tonight since there is no pooling water and no scalding water
If pooling water or overheating appears tonight: switch off the water heater's breaker and close the cold-water inlet valve on top of the tank, do not drain it yourself [PB-04]
ticket.customer_message: You're all set — Tue Sep 1, 10:30 AM, water heater flush & sediment service, $139 flat, about 75 minutes. Nothing you need to do beforehand: leave it running as normal, just clear a path to the tank so the tech can get around it. The only 'if' is the one from earlier — pooling water or scalding water tonight means breaker off + cold inlet valve closed [PB-04] and call us. Otherwise, sleep easy. See you tomorrow, Denis!
